Ukraine War Sees Naval Drone Strike on Russian Ship in Libya, Airspace Violations

Ukraine has claimed responsibility for a naval drone attack that sank a Russian warship off the coast of Libya, over 1,000 miles from the main conflict zone. Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky stated that seven naval drones were used in the attack near Benghazi, demonstrating Kyiv's ability to strike Russian interests globally. Separately, Finland summoned the Russian ambassador after a Russian helicopter was suspected of violating Finnish airspace on Saturday afternoon near Loviisa. Meanwhile, Russian strikes in the Kyiv region reportedly killed at least nine people, with one report stating 14 deaths, and a Ukrainian drone was reported to have landed less than a mile from Wes Streeting in Kyiv.
